title: Get Map Working End to End
description: Get GIS/map (dev:gis:2d) working end to end. Build currently fails with missing `presence` field on UiInspectorFieldGroup in gis/plugin/rs/lib.rs. Fix compile errors and any further blockers so the map app runs.
summary: GIS/map failed to compile (UiInspectorFieldGroup missing presence) and then failed to boot (playground app id gis2d/gis3d vs plugin gis2d-play/gis3d-play). Added presence defaults in gis/plugin/rs/lib.rs; aligned Cargo.toml playground+asset app ids and regenerated the plugin registry. Verified: wasm release build ok; SEMIO_RENDERER=react dev:gis:2d serves http://127.0.0.1:6040/ as semio · gis · 2d with Map canvas, Document/Catalogue/Inspection chrome, and Reuse Map example (Playwright).
